name: Wind Farm
desc: A wind farm strung along four ranks of receding ridgeline — rotors turn at their own rates rank by rank so the field is never in step, towers thin and pale into aerial haze toward the horizon, a cloud band drags across the dusk sky and the whole array reads as slow relentless machinery on the land; overcast dusk, warm gold-hour silhouettes, a night with soft aviation lights, a cyan turbine blueprint, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: how hard the light works — aviation-light glow, blade brightness, ambient

scale.doc: how large the turbines are — rotor radius and tower height (rebuilds the array)

density.doc: how many turbines stand on each ridge

spin.doc: how fast the blades turn independent of speed

haze.doc: how thick the aerial haze is — how far back the ranks fade

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default cool grey sky

x.doc: which way the light comes from across the ridges

y.doc: the near ridge line — low y raises the ranks and gives more sky

style.doc: aesthetic: dusk = overcast cool grey ridges, pale turbines silhouetted; goldhour = dark turbines against warm amber sky; nocturne = night blue-dark with soft red aviation lights; blueprint = cyan schematic, turbines as line diagrams with rotor circles; ink = sumi silhouette ridges and turbines

act.doc: multi-minute programme — a steady wind, gusts surging and easing the rotors over sections, or a near-calm where the blades barely turn

seed.doc: regenerates the ridge profiles, turbine placement and rotor phases

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
